headline: COPPER BOUNCES 1.8% TO $14,334/T AS LME WAREHOUSE STOCKS STABILIZE — Five-Week Low May Be In
snippet: Three-month LME copper surged 1.8% to $14,334 a metric ton Friday as warehouse inventories stabilized after a four-session build, tempering fears of a sustained demand collapse. The rebound follows a 1.9% drop that tested a five-week low, with traders watching key support at $13,925 — the September nadir.

headline: SSR MINING BIDS $464M FOR ROXMORE — NEVADA GOLD DEAL CONSOLIDATES MARIGOLD DISTRICT
snippet: SSR Mining has agreed to acquire Roxmore Resources in a deal valued at approximately US$464 million, adding a Nevada gold project directly adjacent to SSR's existing Marigold mine. The deal consolidates ground in one of North America's most productive gold belts as majors compete for near-mine ounces ahead of anticipated production gaps.

headline: NVRO METALS RACES C$35M RAISE TO FUND UNDISCLOSED ACQUISITION — CLOSE EXPECTED OCTOBER 27
snippet: NVRO Metals is targeting a C$35 million private placement expected to close around October 27, with all proceeds earmarked for an acquisition that has not yet been publicly named. The tight timeline and specific sizing suggest a small-to-mid-cap asset deal is imminent — watch for the target announcement early next week.

headline: LUCA MINING C$155M PLACEMENT CLOSED — CAPSTONE COPPER COZAMIN MINE DEAL ON TRACK FOR Q1 2027
snippet: Luca Mining has completed a C$155 million private placement to fund its acquisition of Capstone Copper's Cozamin silver-copper mine in Zacatecas, Mexico. The deal closes by February 28, 2027, transforming Luca into a multi-asset mid-tier producer with a high-margin Mexican copper-silver operation.

headline: VALE EXITS THOMPSON NICKEL — EXIRO MINERALS TAKES CONTROL OF HISTORIC MANITOBA COMPLEX
snippet: Vale Base Metals completed the sale of control of its Thompson nickel complex to Exiro Minerals on October 16, continuing Vale's strategic withdrawal from Canadian nickel. Thompson has produced nickel continuously since 1961; the handoff marks a generational shift for Manitoba's mining sector and opens a new junior chapter for the asset.

headline: SUN PEAK METALS MOBILIZES TWO DRILLS AT SAFRA VMS IN SAUDI ARABIA — 3,000M CAMPAIGN BEGINS
snippet: Sun Peak Metals (TSXV: PEAK) has mobilized two diamond drill rigs for a 3,000-meter program at its 100%-owned Safra volcanogenic massive sulphide project in Saudi Arabia, targeting copper, zinc, gold, and silver. The project sits in an underexplored geological terrane and represents one of few TSX-V juniors active in the Arabian Peninsula.

headline: ALPHA EXPLORATION OPENS SECOND GOLD DRILL FRONT — ABURNA AND BONAPARTE BOTH ACTIVE
snippet: Alpha Exploration has completed its enlarged 2026 drill program at Aburna gold and simultaneously opened a second front at Bonaparte, where DDH-BN-7 is now underway. Operating two exploration fronts at once signals a material escalation in the company's pace and ambitions at its flagship African gold program.

headline: AURA ENERGY TIRIS URANIUM: $500M FEASIBILITY PUTS MAURITANIA'S FIRST MINE IN REACH
snippet: Aura Energy's Tiris uranium project in Mauritania has been valued at approximately US$500 million in a recently completed feasibility study, advancing what would be the country's first uranium mine. Security conditions in the Sahel region and funding pathways remain the key gating items ahead of a construction decision.

headline: NINE FOREIGN MINERS STAKE GUYANA IN 2026 — GUIANA SHIELD DEAL FLOW RIVALS WEST AFRICA
snippet: Nine foreign companies have struck deals for Guyanese mining properties in 2026, underscoring the country's rise as one of the premier gold jurisdictions in the Americas. The deal surge reflects a broader race to acquire assets on the Guiana Shield, a geological mirror of Brazil's prolific Quadrilátero Ferrífero mining district.

headline: COPPER, URANIUM, LITHIUM ALL TEST KEY SUPPORT — FOMC WEEK SELLOFF PUTS CRITICAL METALS AT INFLECTION
snippet: FXEmpire's October 23 technical analysis maps critical metals at a crossroads: copper must hold $6.35/lb, uranium faces a test of its recent run near $89/lb spot, and lithium carbonate has already shed 25% in a month. With the FOMC rate decision due October 28, a hawkish surprise could accelerate the selloff across all three.

headline: TWO RARE EARTH JUNIORS BUILDING THE SUPPLY CHAIN THAT ENDS CHINA'S 90% PROCESSING GRIP
snippet: A Stockhouse analysis profiles two rare earth juniors building processing capacity outside China, arriving as Beijing's July 2026 export control announcement formalizes penalties for violations of strategic mineral reporting rules. The piece maps how non-Chinese projects are gaining urgency as the policy backdrop tightens.

headline: ATOMIC EAGLE DRILLS 81-86% URANIUM RECOVERIES AT MUNTANGA EAST — ZAMBIAN RESOURCE BUILD ADVANCES
snippet: Atomic Eagle has reported drill recoveries of 81% to 86% at Muntanga East, confirming uranium mineralization continuity and underpinning a resource estimate build at the Zambian project. The results add a meaningful data point to Africa's growing uranium exploration pipeline beyond the traditional Namibian and Tanzanian corridors.
